newsitem.title: USA: Sunbelt modifies pact with Pier 1.
newsitem.headline: Sunbelt modifies pact with Pier 1.

text.p: Sunbelt Nursery Group Inc said Wednesday it may discharge a $8 million note due to Pier 1 Imports Inc for up to $2 million.
The plan is part of a modified settlement reached with Pier 1, Sunbelt said. Sunbelt said it expects to to fulfill the terms of the new agreement before the close of the current fiscal year.

"With significant future cash flows no longer committed to Pier 1, our shareholders can now see direct benefits from improved operations and that immediately enhances shareholder value," Sunbelt Chief Executive Thomas Duoos said in a statement.
The original settlement, which was reached in July 1995, involved a dispute over the disposal of properties that Pier 1 had built when it had a controlling interest in Sunbelt, a spokesman said.
